mirror3-fix: Keep this image exactly as it is (same composition, same camera, same crag of ice, same black mirror with the kneeling figure inside it, same red sky), but change the creatures. The four tall spiked figures holding spears become ice devils: hulking twelve-foot insect-like devils with a pale blue-white chitinous carapace rimed with frost instead of dark armour, heads like a giant mantis or beetle with bulging faceted eyes, long antennae and heavy mandibles, clawed insect hands, and a long thick segmented tail ending in a club of spikes behind each one. They keep their poses and their barbed spears of black ice. The thin human skeleton at the centre becomes a bone devil: a gaunt nine-foot devil, bigger and heavier than a man, with dry yellowed hide stretched tight over its bones, a horned, fanged, skull-like head, large ragged bat-like wings half open behind it, and the same long bony scorpion tail arched over its shoulder, holding a hooked polearm.
